name: Azeriel, Arckcestial of Demise
printed_text:
2 Level 4 "Arckcestial" monsters, including a LIGHT Synchro Monster
If this card is Xyz Summoned: You can send 1 "Arckcestial" monster from your Deck to the GY. You can detach 1 material from this card; add 1 "Rank-Up-Magic" Spell from your Deck to your hand. If you Special Summon an "Arckcestial" Xyz or Synchro Monster(s): You can Special Summon this card from your GY in Defense Position, then you can add 1 "Rank-Up-Magic" Spell from your GY to your hand. If this card is detached from an "Arckcestial" Xyz Monster to activate that monster's effect: You can destroy 1 face-up card on the field. You can only use each effect of "Azeriel, Arckcestial of Demise" once per turn.
